sections.Profile:
The "Hearts Spades" pinball machine, produced by Allied Leisure Industries Inc. in 1978, is a solid-state, cocktail table-style game designed for two players. The playfield features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, nine standup targets, eight star rollovers, and two drop targets. Notably, it retains traditional chimes for sound, blending classic auditory elements with its modern design. The game was designed by Bob Betor, with artwork by R. Michael Torrey.
